source.notes: ICSE Grade VIII school assessment paper (school not named). Header prints 'GRADE VIII', 'ASSESSMENT II', 'CHEMISTRY', 'M.M. 80' (the figure is partly overwritten by a handwritten mark on the scan). No year and no duration are printed; examYear 2025 is taken from the file name (icse-class-8-assessment-2-chemistry-280425-2025, date 28-04-25 in the name). The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images; handwritten marks on the scan were ignored. Section A (40 marks, Questions 1-7) is compulsory and each question prints only a group total, so each is kept as one entry (part null). Section B (40 marks) says 'Attempt any five questions' and prints Questions 1-6 (numbering restarts; parts labelled 'a)'/'b)'), 8 marks each, so the pack totals 88. Subscripts were rebuilt from the page images. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text: Choose the correct answers to the question from the given options: a. A crystalline form of carbon is i) Lamp black ii) gas carbon iii) sugar iv) fullerene b. Water returns on earth's surface from the atmosphere by the process of: i) Combustion ii) respiration iii) photosynthesis iv) condensation c. The process of photosynthesis takes place in the presence of i) Electricity ii) Heat iii) Light iv) Sound d. Water gas is a mixture of i) CO and oxygen ii) Hydrogen and oxygen iii) CO and Hydrogen iv) none of these e. Temporary hardness of water can be removed by i) Filtering ii) Boiling these iii) Loading iv) None of these f. The gas produced at anode when electrolysis of water is done is i) H₂ ii) O₂ iii) SO₂ iv) None of these
